prompt: Create a finished, polished UI screen mockup (full-screen game UI design, 3:2 layout) for the action-RPG "Echoes of the Shatter". CONSISTENCY (mandatory): attached image 1 is our approved HUD mockup and attached image 2 is our approved icon sheet: use exactly the same UI language, dark violet-grey organic stone frames (#2A222F body, #161117 gaps, #0F0B14 outlines) with thorny corners, a thin gold filigree line (#D9A441, highlight #FCD58A), bevelled stone buttons, lava-orange/crimson fills for life, amber for resource, and the same icon painting style (dark #161117 icon background, gold-framed squares with a small gem at the bottom). Attached image 3 is the canonical Warrior sheet (golden visor helmet with red plume, red tabard, stone-inlay kite shield, stone block hammer): any hero shown is that Warrior exactly. Attached images 4 to 6 are UI sheets of another game, only a style reference for finish and brushwork; do not copy any of their elements. Hand-painted, chunky bevelled shapes, warm gold accents only where it matters, never pure black, strong readable hierarchy, clear contrast between panels and content. NO readable text, no letters, no real numbers, no watermark: wherever text or numbers would be, draw abstract glyph-like marks, short rune-like dashes and tiny pictograms. Rarity is shown by frame shape and color: common plain bevelled corner, magic blue (#6FA8FF) simple corner filigree, rare gold (#FFD24A) double corners, unique orange (#FF8A2E) thorny corners with glow. SCREEN: MAIN MENU. Full-screen painted background of the Marco Refuge at night: a small walled camp of dark stone ruins with warm lanterns and a campfire, a glowing golden memory-shard crystal standing in the middle, shattered floating towers and a giant cracked bell silhouette in a deep violet-blue sky, the Warrior standing small from behind in the lower left. Top center: a large carved-stone game logo plate made of bold rune-like shapes (no readable letters) with a cracked gold shard motif. Right or center-left column: a vertical stack of 5 wide bevelled stone buttons with gold filigree, the top one (Continue) larger, highlighted with a bright gold focus ring and a warm glow, and a small portrait of the Warrior with glyph lines (name, class, level, area) as a caption beneath it, plus a small gold badge with a tiny scroll icon (expedition ready) on the top button; the other four buttons are plain (new game, load, options, quit), each with a tiny glyph icon at the left. Bottom-left a tiny logs-folder icon link, bottom-right a small version glyph string. Cinematic, calm, adventurous with a melancholic edge.
